<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an SN2 reaction where a C‑Cl bond is broken and a C‑N bond is formed in the forward direction. In the retrosynthetic direction, this means breaking the C‑N bond in the target molecule to give a halide (C‑Cl) and a nucleophilic amine. We'll search the template catalog for templates that break a “halide” functional group and form an “amine” (C‑N) in the forward reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
